newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Angola to train police for Kabila's Congo.
newsitem.headline: Angola to train police for Kabila's Congo.

text.p: Angola is to train police and immigration officers for Laurent Kabila's Democratic Republic of the Congo in a drive to improve border security between the two neighbours, state radio reported on Wednesday.
It said interior ministers of the two countries agreed on the plan at a two-day meeting in Kinshasa, capital of the former Zaire.
The neighbours share a 2,600 km (1,600 mile) border.

Relations were bad under Zairean dictator Mobutu Sese Seko, ousted by Kabila in May. Mobutu supported UNITA leader Jonas Savimbi, who fought the Angolan government. Angolan President Jose Eduardo Dos Santos attended Kabila's inauguration.
